title: Pointer Ridge Swim & Racquet Club

services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: Safety is our main concern. Lessons will be held if it is just raining and no lightning is in the area. Lessons will be put on hold if an electrical storm moves through the area. If we must cancel a lesson for a day, we will try to make up the missed time during the subsequent lessons. Delays/cancellation notifications will be sent to the email used during

blurb: Open Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day Weekend, our facilities include three pools (including a 6-lane, 25-meter lap pool; a family pool and a fenced-in baby pool), four tennis courts, a beach volleyball court, playground, horseshoe pits, BBQ grills, a bonfire pit, and multiple party areas.
